senses.gloss:
(औ) मृशौ r. 6th cl. (मृशति)
1 To touch.
2 To see, to perceive.
3 To consult, to consider, to deliberate.
With परा,
To counsel, to advise.
With वि,
To consider, to discuss.

r. 1st and 10th cls. (मर्षति-ते मर्षयति-ते) and 4th cl. (मृष्यति-ते)
To bear, to suffer, to endure patiently.
(उ) मृषु r. 1st cl. (मर्षति)
To sprinkle.
With आङ्,
To be angry.
With वि,
To be distressed, to bear hardly.

ind.
1 Falsely.
2 Uselessly, in vain.
E.
मृष to bear, with का aff.

n. (-कं)
An impossibility, an absurdity, (in speech or composition); the sense of which is evidently false, as कूर्म्मलोमतनुत्राणः, शशशृङ्गधनुर्धरः, his armour is of tortoise wool, and his bow the horn of a hare.
E.
मृषा falsely, अर्थ meaning, कन् added.

m. (-दः)
1 Irony, ironical praise.
2 Falsehood.
E.
मृषा falsely, and वाद speech, praise.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
Speaking falsely, lying, a liar.
m. (-दी)
A false accuser, one who brings forward an unjust or unfounded accusation.
E.
मृषा falsely, and वादिन् who speaks.

mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
Speaking falsely, lying, a liar.
n. (-द्यं)
Falsehood.
E.
मृषा falsely, वद to speak, aff. क्यप्.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Cleaned, cleansed.
2 Touched, rubbed.
3 Sprinkled.
E.
मृज to clean, or मृष to rub, &c., aff. क्त.

f. (-ष्टिः)
1 Touching, contact.
2 Cleaning.
3 Sprinkling.
4 Preparing the food for a meal.
E.
मृज to clean, or मृष to sprinkle, &c., क्तिन् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 A liberal man, a donor, a benefactor.
2 A churlish or inhospitable man.
3 An eater of sweetmeats.
